newsitem.title: USA: American apparently rejects pilots' offer.
newsitem.headline: American apparently rejects pilots' offer.

text.p: A top negotiator for American Airlines' pilots said on Thursday he understood that the carrier had rejected the union's latest offer aimed at averting a strike.
"It's my understanding that the company has rejected it," said Brian Mayhew, chairman of the union's negotiating committee.
Mayhew said the company's apparent rejection involved the union proposal to have its pilots fly the airline's American Eagle planes at what he called "competitive" salaries.
A company official who spoke earlier, however, made no reference to such a rejection, saying only that American had concerns about the proposal.

The issue of the smaller jets has been a major sticking point in the protracted negotiations between the two sides. American wants to continue using lower-paid commuter pilots from a different union to fly the American Eagle routes.
